workLog.outcome: Confirmed compliance-bot owns pull_request_read still bypassed the analyst retrieval guard. Replaced the actor-boundary verb list for bot or agent subjects with open-ended verb detection, preserved the tool-subject and list-item controls, and verified 118 analyst resolution tests plus ruff.

workLog.task: Resolve PR 4817 blockquoted code fence review thread
workLog.outcome: Reproduced the finding at branch head 80df0962af: a routing table inside > ``` or inside a blockquoted four-space indent parsed as four live routes because _compute_operative_lines inspected the raw line. Added _strip_blockquote_markers, which strips > plus at most one space and preserves inner indentation, and routed fence and indented-code detection through it. Five negative controls added. 270 tests pass, ruff check and ruff format clean.

workLog.task: Resolve PR 4817 rescan threads: table interruption and fronted tool phrase
workLog.outcome: Reproduced both. A fence or multi-line HTML comment inside a routing table only skipped that row, so orphan rows after it completed the route set; any non-operative line now ends the table. Strategy 4 searched the whole pre-verb prefix, so 'The compliance-bot calls pull_request_read before the analyst retrieves cache' passed; the prefix must now match the anchored 'Using or Via <tool>, the analyst' shape. Seven controls added, 328 targeted tests pass.

retrospective.failureMode: Detection logic and consumption logic normalized the same input differently. _compute_operative_lines read raw lines while _parse_routing_table read blockquote-stripped lines, so any prefix one stage strips and the other does not becomes a bypass.
retrospective.rootCause: Two strippers with different contracts existed without a stated boundary. _strip_blockquote discards all whitespace after the marker, which destroys the indentation that separates blockquoted code from blockquoted prose, so it can never decide code context.
retrospective.remediation: Kept both strippers and documented the boundary in each docstring so a future reader does not collapse them and reintroduce the bypass. Negative controls now cover backtick, tilde, nested, and indented blockquote forms plus the closed-fence pass-through.
retrospective.observation: The merge-tree-ratchet pre-push job failed twice with 'ruff could not read <scratch>/tests/skills/doc-accuracy/__init__.py' while the same command passed twice standalone against the same base. Each run materializes its own scratch tree, so the read failure points at a concurrency interaction between the merge-tree-ratchet job and the count ratchets inside pre-pr-validation, not at this branch's diff.
